scripts.dev:infra: WORKER_BACKEND_URL=http://host.docker.internal:3000 docker compose --profile dev-infra up -d postgres redis minio mailhog pdf-parser-worker solver-worker
scripts.sync: docker compose up -d postgres redis minio mailhog && sleep 5 && pnpm install && pnpm db:migrate
scripts.workers:test: pnpm --filter bullmq-worker-core test && pnpm --filter pdf-parser-worker test && pnpm --filter solver-worker test && make -C apps/preference-solver test
scripts.workers:smoke: pnpm docker:build:workers:native && pnpm docker:smoke:pdf-parser-worker && pnpm docker:smoke:solver-worker
scripts.workers:e2e: WORKER_BACKEND_URL=http://host.docker.internal:3000 docker compose --profile dev-infra up -d --build redis minio pdf-parser-worker solver-worker && docker compose ps pdf-parser-worker | grep -q "Up" && docker compose ps solver-worker | grep -q "Up"
scripts.validate: pnpm docker:config && pnpm test:unit && pnpm workers:test && pnpm workers:smoke && pnpm workers:e2e && pnpm audit --prod --ignore-registry-errors
scripts.docker:build:all:native: docker compose build backend frontend pdf-parser-worker solver-worker
scripts.docker:build:all:multiarch: DOCKER_PLATFORMS=${DOCKER_PLATFORMS:-linux/amd64,linux/arm64}; test -n "${IMAGE_TAG:-}" || { echo 'IMAGE_TAG is required' >&2; exit 2; }; docker buildx build --platform "$DOCKER_PLATFORMS" -f docker/backend/backend.Dockerfile -t "${DOCKER_REGISTRY:-vigilcs/umtas}:backend-${IMAGE_TAG}" --push . && docker buildx build --platform "$DOCKER_PLATFORMS" -f docker/frontend/frontend.Dockerfile -t "${DOCKER_REGISTRY:-vigilcs/umtas}:frontend-${IMAGE_TAG}" --push . && docker buildx build --platform "$DOCKER_PLATFORMS" -f docker/pdf-parser-worker/pdf-parser-worker.Dockerfile -t "${DOCKER_REGISTRY:-vigilcs/umtas}:pdf-parser-worker-${IMAGE_TAG}" --push . && docker buildx build --platform "$DOCKER_PLATFORMS" -f docker/solver-worker/solver-worker.Dockerfile -t "${DOCKER_REGISTRY:-vigilcs/umtas}:solver-worker-${IMAGE_TAG}" --push .
scripts.docker:config: docker compose config --quiet && IMAGE_TAG=${IMAGE_TAG:-validation} docker compose -f docker-compose.staging.yml config --quiet && IMAGE_TAG=${IMAGE_TAG:-validation} docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml config --quiet
